depiction.primary_object: two vertical parallel bars inside a broken circle
modifiers: circular progress ring with top-left gap and dot
depiction.composition: centered pause symbol enclosed by a circular track with a dot in the break

readings.meaning: put project or activity on hold
take a break or rest interval

ambiguity: At small sizes, the outer ring with the dot looks almost identical to a standard circular pause button or an electrical power outlet.

modifier_semantics.modifier: circular progress ring with top-left gap and dot
modifier_semantics.meaning: ongoing time, progress, or active cycle being interrupted

task_intents: put a current project on hold
schedule a rest break between intervals

example_tasks.task: Pause the newspaper delivery while we are in Portugal
Put the kitchen remodel contractor search on hold until spring
Pause Google Ads campaign before the monthly budget resets Friday
Temporarily freeze Patreon billing for the three podcasts I'm behind on
Set up automatic fifteen-minute screen breaks on the work laptop
Pause Time Machine hourly backups while rendering the wedding video
Biweekly lawn mowing service during the August drought
Legacy mobile app refactor until Q3 staffing is decided
Call the student loan servicer to ask about putting payments on forbearance until November
Pause the cat litter auto-ship on Chewy because we still have three unopened boxes
Ask HR how to pause commuter transit pre-tax deductions while working from home next month

example_tasks_es: Pausar la cuota del gimnasio durante agosto
Congelar la suscripción de café en grano mientras estamos de viaje
Poner en pausa las campañas de anuncios antes del cierre del trimestre
example_tasks_ru: Заморозить абонемент в фитнес-клуб на время отпуска
Поставить на паузу доставку воды до конца августа
Приостановить автоплатёж за облачное хранилище на пару месяцев

context_tasks.task: Fix the sticking pause button on the living room Apple TV remote
Configure Pomodoro timer intervals in the menu bar app
Review all monthly recurring charges on the Chase card
Take a week off running to let the shin splints calm down

near_misses.task: Buy a European two-pin plug adapter for the hairdryer
Set a 45-minute oven timer for the sourdough loaf
Check which annual subscriptions renew next month
Ask the landlord to replace the broken kitchen faucet
Download offline podcasts for the long layover

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a pause symbol enclosed in a timer or progress ring. While originally a media or timer UI control, in a task manager it is genuinely useful for tasks about pausing subscriptions, freezing memberships, or putting projects and deliveries on hold, though it looks very similar to a plain pause button.
